newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: L.Lease sells 15 mln Westpac shrs.
newsitem.headline: L.Lease sells 15 mln Westpac shrs.

text.p: Property and financial services group Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it had sold 15 million shares in Westpac Banking Corp for A$7.00 each, raising A$105 million.
"The profit of this transaction will be largely applied against anticipated writedowns in the valuation of the Grand Central property in Melbourne," Lend Lease said.
County Natwest crossed the Westpac parcel around midday.
Westpac shares closed 23.7 cents down at A$6.873 with 17.82 million shares traded.
Lend Lease held 65 million Westpac shares before Wednesday's sale, representing about three percent of its issued capital.
The company last year offloaded a six percent stake in Westpac via a warrants issue which was handled by County Natwest as well. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
